responsibility: This header declares the mc-boot runtime's DynamicStrings-based numeric conversion API. It exposes the broad set of functions for converting integer, cardinal, long integer/cardinal, short cardinal, and long-real values to and from strings across multiple bases, along with convenience decimal parsers/formatters and floating-point rounding helpers, defining the main high-level conversion contract used by neighboring formatting and I/O modules.
same_name_distinction: This .h file is the declaration half of the GStringConvert pair, listing the broad DynamicStrings-based conversion and rounding entry points, while gcc/m2/mc-boot/GStringConvert.cc implements the actual integer and floating-point conversion machinery.
